name: Runner Extras - SingleInstance Codeunit State
brief: Proves SingleInstance=true codeunits share exactly one instance per session, so instance-variable state persists across separate calls within a test, and does not leak into a fresh test.
description: Reproduces the Pageworks PageworksCopilotSession gap: NavCodeunitHandle_CreateTarget always constructed a fresh instance, so a SingleInstance codeunit that set a field in one call saw it reset to default on the next call. RED (before the fix): a value set via one call is read back as the default via a separate call. GREEN (after the fix): the value round-trips. A second, non-SingleInstance codeunit proves ordinary codeunits keep fresh-instance semantics. A third test proves the SingleInstance cache resets at the test boundary (no cross-test leakage).
